content.about: The United States stretches across North America from the Atlantic to the Pacific, plus Alaska and Hawaii. It has deserts, mountains, forests and big cities. It is a world leader in technology and film. The Grand Canyon is one of its famous sights.

standout.text: Yellowstone, created in 1872, was the world's first national park.

didYouKnow: The US has no official language at the federal level.
Alaska's Denali is North America's highest peak.
Hawaii is still growing from volcanic eruptions.
